items.title: The strict transform along the Fitting ideal locus is locally generated by few sections
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a finite type quasi-coherent F on S with Z_k cut out by Fit_k(F), if S' -> S is the blowup in Z_k and F' is the strict transform of F, then F' can locally be generated by at most k sections (source lines 9302-9312). The proof performs the translation in two named steps: the Fitting criterion identifies 'generated locally by at most k sections' with Fit_k(F') = O_{S'}, and the corresponding blowup statement for Fitting ideals over a ring supplies the algebra content.
